institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care knowledge (NCCN/DeVita/Harrison, general reference); experimental, not clinically activated

name: Glofitamab (CD20xCD3 bispecific, fixed duration)

premedications.name: Obinutuzumab pretreatment
premedications.notes: single 1000 mg obinutuzumab dose 7 days before the first glofitamab dose to deplete B cells and blunt cytokine-release syndrome

premedications.name: CRS premedication
premedications.notes: steroid + antihistamine + antipyretic before each step-up and the first full dose

supportiveCare: Step-up dosing during cycle 1 to mitigate cytokine-release syndrome; hospital observation per risk
Fixed duration: stop after up to 12 cycles
monitoring: Cytokine-release syndrome and neurotoxicity (ICANS), highest at the first full dose

drugs.name: Obinutuzumab (pretreatment)
drugs.notes: Single 1000 mg IV pretreatment dose ~7 days before glofitamab step-up.

drugs.name: Glofitamab
drugs.notes: Step-up in cycle 1 (2.5 mg on day 8, 10 mg on day 15), then 30 mg IV on day 1 of cycles 2-12 (target full dose shown).
